description: This Java class `EnterpriseApplication` initializes and runs an embedded Jetty web server, sets up a web application context with specified resources and configuration, and manages server lifecycle including graceful shutdown.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class for starting and managing a Jetty web server with web application context.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes and starts the Jetty server, configures web application context, and adds shutdown hooks.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Retrieves a resource URL as string from classloader, throws RuntimeException if resource is not found.

methods.name: getResourceFilePath
methods.description: Gets the filesystem path of a resource, throws RuntimeException if resource is not found.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Resolves server port from system property; defaults to 8090 if property is not set or invalid.
